name: Sampled-values missing-stream alarm
summary: Reports loss of the assigned measurement stream at its subscriber.
description: Reports loss of the assigned measurement stream at its subscriber. Digital substation interfaces carry measurements, status and control information between primary equipment and protective devices. Measurement streams, event messages and time synchronization are separate dependencies even when they share an Ethernet network.

In a digital substation bay, a merging unit digitizes local measurements and a protective relay subscribes to the assigned data stream. The command return path and communication-health indications are drawn separately. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Stream reception supervision” at the input and “Missing measurement alarm” at the output. The protection fallback must be separately defined.
